name: Alek Amrani
biography: is currently an Information Security Programmer for the Information Security Office at the University of Texas at Austin where he is also pursuing a degree in Computer Science. He's interested in all areas of security from physical to computational, and is also the vice-president of the Longhorn LockPicking Club. Generally described by his friends as 'paranoid', Alek enjoys introducing himself as people he's not, looking over his shoulder, taking different routes home, and creating new passwords in his spare time.
